My round-1 real boot of ff4d51c8 over such a row (local Postgres 17.11, replay seed migrated to 0136 by base bb9fe49c) exited with `apply migration 137: ... invalid input syntax for type uuid: "not-a-uuid" (SQLSTATE 22P02)`, and the schema stayed at 136. As the architect directed, the implementer replaces it with a test that boots over such a row (Envoy 1eafbff6).
